title: Kozakuran Dictionary

sources.title: Investigate Cazador's Palace
markers: | description = Investigate Cazador's Palace is a quest in Act Three of Baldur's Gate 3. It can be started by speaking with Ulma in Rivington or the vampire spawn at Fraygo's Flophouse.

summary: Read the Kozakuran Dictionary to gain 95 XP and advance Investigate Cazador’s Palace.

fields.Use: Read to learn the incantation required to open the Sinister Door. The Szarr Family Ring is also required.
fields.Acquisition: In a mahogany wardrobe in the lower-floor room with Victoria’s cursed body. Its Vitality Drain deals 4d6 + 4 Necrotic per turn. Remove Curse on the body makes the room safe.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added reviewed native BG3 gameplay and pinned item and dependency revisions.
